paragraphs: Sun Communities, Inc., and all wholly-owned or majority-owned and controlled subsidiaries, including Sun Communities Operating Limited Partnership, a Michigan limited partnership (the "Operating Partnership"), Sun Home Services, Inc. ("SHS"), and our Park Holidays subsidiaries and the other entities through which we operate our business in the United Kingdom ("UK") are referred to herein as the "Company," "SUI," "us," "we," or "our."

We are a fully integrated real estate investment trust ("REIT"). We own manufactured housing ("MH") and recreational vehicle ("RV") communities in the United States ("U.S."), Canada, and the UK (together with MH and RV, the "properties"). We self-administer, self-manage, operate, or hold an interest in, and develop the majority of our properties, and a select number of our communities are operated by independent third-party contractors on our behalf under management agreements. Others are operated by lessees under ground lease arrangements. Together with our affiliates and predecessors, we have been in the business of operating, acquiring, developing, and expanding MH and RV communities since 1975 and communities in the UK since 2022.

For our MH and RV businesses, we lease individual parcels of land, or sites, with utility access for the placement of manufactured homes and RVs to our MH and RV customers. Our MH communities are designed to offer affordable housing to individuals and families, while also providing certain amenities. Our RV communities are designed to offer affordable vacation opportunities to individuals and families complemented by a diverse selection of high-quality amenities. Through SHS, a taxable REIT subsidiary, we market, sell, and lease new and pre-owned homes to current and future residents in our MH and RV communities. The operations of SHS support and enhance our occupancy levels, property performance, and cash flows.

In the UK, our communities are referred to as "holiday parks" and are located predominantly at irreplaceable seaside destinations in the south of England. We sell homes to holiday homeowners who lease a pitch at one of our properties through a site fee license arrangement. In addition, we sell new and pre-owned homes to current and prospective customers, and provide vacation opportunities to individuals and families complemented by high-quality amenities.

As of December 31, 2025, we owned and operated, directly or indirectly, or had an interest in, a portfolio of 513 developed properties located in the U.S., Canada, and the UK, including 294 MH communities, 166 RV communities, and 53 UK communities. As of December 31, 2025, the properties contained an aggregate of 178,650 developed sites comprised of 100,150 developed MH sites, 33,330 annual RV sites (inclusive of both annual and seasonal usage rights), 23,550 transient RV sites, 17,750 UK annual sites, and 3,870 UK transient RV sites.

Our executive and principal property management office is located at 27777 Franklin Road, Suite 300, Southfield, Michigan 48034, and our telephone number is (248) 208-2500. Our Park Holidays principal office is located in Bexhill-on-Sea, East Sussex, UK. We have regional property management offices throughout the U.S. We employed an aggregate of 3,614 full and part time employees as of December 31, 2025.

Our website address is www.suninc.com and we make available, free of charge, on or through our website all of our periodic reports, including our Annual Reports on Form 10-K, Quarterly Reports on Form 10-Q, and current reports on Form 8-K, as soon as reasonably practicable after we file such reports with the SEC. Additionally, the SEC maintains a website at https://www.sec.gov, that contains reports, proxy information statements, and other information about us.

From 2020 through 2024, we were in the business of operating, acquiring, developing, and expanding marinas through our Safe Harbor Marinas, LLC subsidiary ("Safe Harbor"). In February 2025, we entered into a definitive agreement to sell Safe Harbor for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $5.65 billion, subject to certain adjustments (the "Safe Harbor Sale"). During the three months ended June 30, 2025, we completed the initial closing of the Safe Harbor Sale, which generated approximately $5.25 billion of pre-tax cash proceeds, net of transaction costs. The subsequent closing of the transfer of subsidiaries owning 15 of Safe Harbor's properties (the "Delayed Consent Subsidiaries") with an aggregate agreed value of approximately $250.0 million was further subject to the receipt of certain third-party consents. Subsequent to the initial closing through June 30, 2025, we completed the sale of six Delayed Consent Subsidiaries for $136.7 million. On August 29, 2025, we completed the closing of the final nine Delayed Consent Subsidiaries for $117.5 million and fully divested our investment in the Safe Harbor business. In connection with the Safe Harbor Sale, we recorded a gain of $1.5 billion during the year ended December 31, 2025. The Safe Harbor Sale accelerates our strategy of focusing on our core business. Refer to Part II, Item 7, "Liquidity And Capital Resources," and Note 2, "Assets Held for Sale and Discontinued Operations," in our accompanying Consolidated Financial Statements for additional information related to Safe Harbor and the Safe Harbor Sale.
SUN COMMUNITIES, INC. REPORTABLE SEGMENTS

As a result of the Safe Harbor Sale, we have revised our reporting structure from a four-segment to a three-segment structure, which consists of (i) MH communities, (ii) RV communities, and (iii) communities in the UK. Additional information required by this item is incorporated herein by reference to the narrative and tabular description of segments and operating results under Item 7, "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" and Note 10, "Segment Reporting," in our accompanying Consolidated Financial Statements.

The Company is a REIT and the general partner of the Operating Partnership. As the sole general partner of the Operating Partnership, we generally have the power to manage and have complete control over the conduct of the Operating Partnership's affairs, and all decisions or actions made or taken by us as the general partner pursuant to the partnership agreement are generally binding upon all of the partners and the Operating Partnership.

The Operating Partnership is structured as an umbrella partnership REIT ("UPREIT"). We conduct substantially all of our operations through the Operating Partnership, which, directly or indirectly through other subsidiaries, owns substantially all of our assets. This UPREIT structure enables us to comply with certain complex requirements under the federal tax rules and regulations applicable to REITs, and to acquire properties in transactions that defer some or all of the sellers' tax consequences. The financial results of the Operating Partnership and our other subsidiaries are consolidated in our Consolidated Financial Statements. The financial results of the Operating Partnership include certain activities that do not necessarily qualify as REIT activities under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the "Code"). We have formed taxable REIT subsidiaries, as defined in the Code, to engage in such activities. We use taxable REIT subsidiaries to offer certain services to our residents and engage in activities that would not otherwise be permitted under the REIT rules if provided directly by us or by the Operating Partnership. The taxable REIT subsidiaries include our home sales business, SHS, which provides manufactured home sales, leasing, and other services to current and prospective tenants of our properties. Currently, all of our UK operations are conducted through taxable REIT subsidiaries.

Under the partnership agreement, the Operating Partnership is structured to make distributions with respect to certain of the Operating Partnership units ("OP units") at the same time that distributions are made to our common shareholders. The Operating Partnership is structured to permit limited partners holding certain classes or series of OP units to exchange those OP units for shares of our common stock (in a taxable transaction) and achieve liquidity for their investment.

Our future results could differ materially from current results, and our actual results could differ materially from those projected in forward-looking statements as a result of certain risk factors. These risk factors include, but are not limited to, those set forth below, other one-time events, and important factors disclosed previously and from time to time in our other filings with the SEC.
MATERIAL RISKS RELATING TO OUR MH, RV, AND UK BUSINESSES

The market and economic conditions in our current markets generally, and specifically in metropolitan areas of our current markets, may significantly affect occupancy or rental rates. Occupancy and rental rates, in turn, may significantly affect our revenues, and if our properties do not generate revenues sufficient to meet our operating expenses, including debt service and capital expenditures, our cash flows, and ability to pay or refinance our debt obligations could be adversely affected.

As of December 31, 2025, 125 of our MH, RV, and UK communities, representing 26.4% of developed sites, are located in Florida; 89 communities, representing 19.4% of developed sites, are located in Michigan; 53 communities, representing 12.1% of developed sites, are located in the UK; 29 communities, representing 6.1% of developed sites, are located in Texas; and 37 communities, representing 4.9% of developed sites, are located in California. As a result of the geographic concentration of our communities in Florida, Michigan, the UK, Texas, and California, we are exposed to the risks of downturns in local economies or other local real estate market conditions which could adversely affect occupancy rates, rental rates, and property values in these markets.

Our revenue would also be adversely affected if tenants and guests were unable to pay rent or if sites were unable to be rented on favorable terms. If we were unable to promptly relet or renew the leases for a significant number of the sites, or if the rental rates upon such renewal or reletting were significantly lower than expected rates, then our business and results of operations could be adversely affected. In addition, certain expenditures associated with each property (such as real estate taxes and maintenance costs) generally are not reduced when circumstances cause a reduction in income from the property. Furthermore, real estate investments are relatively illiquid and, therefore, will tend to limit our ability to vary our portfolio promptly in response to changes in economic or other conditions.

paragraphs: The following discussion and analysis of the consolidated financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with the Consolidated Financial Statements and accompanying footnotes thereto included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. In addition to the results presented in accordance with GAAP below, we have provided net operating income ("NOI") and FFO information as supplemental performance measures. Refer to Non-GAAP Financial Measures in this Item 7 for additional information.

We are a fully integrated REIT. As of December 31, 2025, we owned and operated, directly or indirectly, or had an interest in, a portfolio of 513 developed properties located in the U.S., Canada, and the UK including 294 MH communities, 166 RV communities, and 53 UK communities.

We have been in the business of operating, acquiring, developing and expanding MH and RV communities since 1975, and communities in the United Kingdom since 2022. We lease individual parcels of land, or sites, with utility access for the placement of manufactured homes and RVs to our MH, RV, and UK customers. Our MH communities are designed to offer affordable housing to individuals and families, while also providing certain amenities. In the U.S., we are also engaged in the marketing, selling and leasing of new and pre-owned homes to current and future residents in our MH communities. The rental program operations within our MH communities support and enhance our occupancy levels, property performance and cash flows. Our RV communities are designed to offer affordable vacation opportunities to individuals and families complemented by a diverse selection of high-quality amenities. In the United Kingdom, our UK communities are referred to as "holiday parks" and are located predominantly at irreplaceable seaside destinations in the south of England. We provide holiday home sales and associated site license activities to holiday homeowners in our communities.

In 2025, we continued our portfolio optimization and simplification strategy by completing the Safe Harbor Sale for total net cash proceeds of $5.5 billion, generating a total gain on sale of $1.5 billion. The Safe Harbor Sale accelerates our strategy of focusing on our core business and significantly enhances our leverage profile and financial flexibility. We have deployed the majority of the cash proceeds from the Safe Harbor Sale to implement a capital allocation plan that reflects a balanced, tax-efficient approach to optimize shareholder value through significantly lower leverage, greater financial flexibility to drive sustainable cash flow growth, and a thoughtful capital return strategy. Refer to Note 2, "Assets Held for Sale and Discontinued Operations," in our accompanying Consolidated Financial Statements for additional details related to the Safe Harbor Sale.

Pursuant to our portfolio optimization strategy, we completed targeted, growth-oriented investment and acquisition opportunities in 2025, while also continuing our targeted disposition program to divest non-strategic assets in an effort to simplify management and maintain financial flexibility. During the year ended December 31, 2025, we acquired 11 MH and three RV properties for total cash consideration of $457.0 million and repurchased the titles to all 32 UK properties that were previously controlled via ground leases for total cash consideration of $386.8 million. Also during the year, we sold four MH properties, three RV properties, and three development land parcels in the U.S. and UK for a gross sale price of $202.6 million. The property dispositions have strengthened our financial position by enabling us to reduce debt while also exiting non-core markets. We remain focused on maximizing real property income, Same Property NOI growth, and Core FFO per share growth, which we believe will enhance long-term shareholder value.

Charles D. Young began serving as our CEO and as a Director on October 1, 2025. Mr. Young succeeds Gary Shiffman, who retired as our CEO after a distinguished 40 years leading Sun Communities. We entered into an employment agreement with Mr. Young under which he will serve as our CEO for a five year term, which is automatically renewable thereafter for successive one-year terms unless either party timely terminates the agreement. Refer to the Form 8-K filed with the SEC on July 23, 2025 for additional details related to Mr. Young's employment agreement.

Mr. Shiffman will continue to serve as the Chairman of our Board of Directors. Refer to the Form 8-K filed with the SEC on December 16, 2025 for additional details related to Mr. Shiffman's transition services agreement.
SUN COMMUNITIES, INC. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY 2025 General Overview
Key operational and financial highlights included the following:
•Completed the disposition of the Safe Harbor Marinas business for an aggregate purchase price of $5.65 billion.

•Acquired 11 MH and three RV properties for total cash consideration of $457.0 million, which was primarily sourced from 1031 exchange escrow accounts to minimize the tax impact from the Safe Harbor Sale.
•Repurchased 4.3 million shares of our common stock at an average cost of $125.62 per share for a total of $539.1 million.
•Completed the redemption of $956.5 million in outstanding unsecured senior notes, inclusive of prepayment costs of $56.5 million.
•Completed the repayment of $1.6 billion under our senior credit facility and $737.7 million of secured mortgage debt, inclusive of prepayments costs of $45.9 million.

paragraphs: Sun Communities, Inc., 以及所有 wholly-owned 或 majority-owned 且受控制的子公司，包括 Sun Communities Operating Limited Partnership，為 Michigan 的有限合夥企業 (the "Operating Partnership"), Sun Home Services, Inc. ("SHS"), 以及我們在英國經營業務的其他實體 ("UK")，於本文件中均稱為 "Company," "SUI," "us," "we," 或 "our."

我們為一間完全整合的不動產投資信託 ("REIT"). 我們擁有美國 ("U.S."), 加拿大，以及英國 ("UK") 的製造住宅 ("MH") 與休閒車 ("RV") 社區，合稱為 "properties". 我們自營管理、自營運作、擁有權益，或開發我們的大部分 properties，並有少數社區由獨立第三方承包商代表我們透過管理契約進行運作。其他社區則由地主透過地租契約進行運作。與我們的關係企業及前身公司一起，我們自 1975 年起從事 MH 與 RV 社區的經營、取得、開發與擴張，自 2022 年起從事英國的社區經營。

針對我們的 MH 與 RV 事業，我們出租個別土地，或稱為 site，並提供電力與其他設施，供 MH 與 RV 客戶安置製造住宅與休閒車。我們的 MH 社區設計為提供個別與家庭可負擔的住宅，同時也提供某些設施。我們的 RV 社區設計為提供個別與家庭可負擔的度假機會，並搭配多樣化的高品質設施。透過 SHS，為一間課稅 REIT 子公司，我們行銷、銷售與出租新舊住宅給目前與未來的 MH 與 RV 社區居民。SHS 的運作支援並提升我們的入住率、社區表現與現金流。
在英國，我們的社區稱為 "holiday parks"，主要位於英格蘭南部不可替代的海岸旅遊勝地。我們銷售住宅給度假住宅所有者，這些所有者透過 site fee license 契約租用我們社區中的某一 site。此外，我們也銷售新舊住宅給目前與潛在客戶，並提供個別與家庭度假機會，搭配高品質設施。

截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們直接或間接擁有並運作，或擁有權益於美國、加拿大與英國的 513 間開發完成的 properties，包括 294 間 MH 社區、166 間 RV 社區與 53 間英國社區。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，這些 properties 合計有 178,650 間開發完成的 site，包括 100,150 間 MH site、33,330 間年度 RV site（包含年度與季節性使用權）、23,550 間臨時 RV site、17,750 間英國年度 site 與 3,870 間英國臨時 RV site。

我們的高層與主要不動產管理辦公室位於 27777 Franklin Road, Suite 300, Southfield, Michigan 48034，電話為 (248) 208-2500。我們的 Park Holidays 主要辦公室位於英國 East Sussex 的 Bexhill-on-Sea。我們在美國設有區域不動產管理辦公室。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們總計僱用 3,614 名全職與半職員工。
我們的網站地址為 www.suninc.com，我們於網站上免費提供所有定期報告，包括年度報告 10-K、季報 10-Q 與現況報告 8-K，於我們向 SEC 提交後儘速提供。此外，SEC 的網站為 https://www.sec.gov，包含我們的報告、股東資料與其他資訊。

從 2020 年至 2024 年，我們透過 Safe Harbor Marinas, LLC 子公司 ("Safe Harbor") 進行經營、取得、開發與擴張船港。2025 年 2 月，我們與買方簽訂最終協議，以約 56.5 億美元總購價出售 Safe Harbor（"Safe Harbor Sale"），此價格需視某些調整而定。在 2025 年 6 月 30 日為止的三個月內，我們完成 Safe Harbor Sale 的初步關閉，產生約 52.5 億美元的預稅現金收入，扣除交易成本後。後續關閉擁有 Safe Harbor 15 間 properties 的子公司（"Delayed Consent Subsidiaries"）的轉讓，總價值約 2.5 億美元，需視取得第三方同意為前提。在 2025 年 6 月 30 日為止的初步關閉後，我們完成出售六間 Delayed Consent Subsidiaries，價值 1.367 億美元。2025 年 8 月 29 日，我們完成最後九間 Delayed Consent Subsidiaries 的關閉，價值 1.175 億美元，並完全退出 Safe Harbor 事業。與 Safe Harbor Sale 相關，我們在 2025 年 12 月 31 日年度內確認 15 億美元的獲利。Safe Harbor Sale 加速我們專注於核心業務的戰略。有關 Safe Harbor 與 Safe Harbor Sale 的更多資訊，請參閱我們附屬的綜合財務資料中的 Part II, Item 7, "Liquidity And Capital Resources," 以及 Note 2, "Assets Held for Sale and Discontinued Operations."
SUN COMMUNITIES, INC. 應報告分部
由於 Safe Harbor Sale，我們已將報告結構從四分部修正為三分部結構，該結構包含 (i) MH 社區、(ii) RV 社區，以及 (iii) 英國社區。本項目所需之額外資訊已於本文件中引用至第 7 項 "管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析" 以及第 10 項 "分部報告" 所述之敘述與表格式分部及營運成果說明，並配合我們附屬之合併財務報表。
本公司為 REIT，並為運營合夥企業之普通合夥人。作為運營合夥企業之唯一普通合夥人，我們通常擁有管理運營合夥企業事務之權力，並對運營合夥企業之業務擁有完全控制權，所有我們作為普通合夥人依合夥協議所作出之決議或行動，通常對所有合夥人及運營合夥企業具有約束力。

運營合夥企業結構為一傘型 REIT（"UPREIT"）。我們透過運營合夥企業進行幾乎所有營運活動，該運營合夥企業，直接或間接透過其他子公司，擁有我們幾乎所有資產。此 UPREIT 結構使我們得以符合 REIT 所適用之聯邦稅務規則與規範之某些複雜要求，並在交易中取得財產，以延後部分或全部賣方之稅務後果。運營合夥企業及其他子公司的財務結果已納入我們之合併財務報表。運營合夥企業之財務結果包含某些活動，這些活動未必符合 1986 年所得稅法典（"Code"）所定義之 REIT 活動。我們已設立可課稅 REIT 子公司，以進行這些活動。我們使用可課稅 REIT 子公司為我們居民提供某些服務，並進行若由我們或運營合夥企業直接提供則不被允許之活動。可課稅 REIT 子公司包括我們之住宅銷售業務 SHS，該業務為我們社區之現有及未來租戶提供製造住宅之銷售、租賃及其他服務。目前，我們所有英國業務均透過可課稅 REIT 子公司進行。
根據合夥協議，運營合夥企業結構設計為在發放運營合夥企業單位（"OP 單位"）之分紅同時，也發放給我們之普通股股東。運營合夥企業結構設計為允許持有特定類別或系列 OP 單位之有限合夥人，將這些 OP 單位交換為我們之普通股股票（在課稅交易中），以實現其投資之流動性。

paragraphs: 下列對整體財務狀況及營運成果之討論與分析，應與本年度10-K申報表所附之合併財務報表及其附註一併閱讀。除下列依美國會計準則（GAAP）所呈現之結果外，我們亦提供淨營運收入（"NOI"）及 FFO 資訊作為補充性績效指標。有關更多非GAAP財務指標資訊，請參閱本項目第7項之「非GAAP財務指標」。
本公司為一完整整合之REIT。截至2025年12月31日，本公司直接或間接擁有並營運，或持有權益於美國、加拿大及英國之513處已開發不動產，包括294處MH社區、166處RV社區及53處英國社區。

自1975年起，本公司從事MH與RV社區之營運、取得、開發與擴張業務，並自2022年起從事英國社區之業務。本公司出租具電力設施之土地或場地，供MH、RV及英國客戶安置製造住宅與RV。本公司MH社區設計為提供個人與家庭可負擔之住宅，同時亦提供若干設施。在美國，本公司亦從事新屋與二手屋之行銷、銷售與出租業務，以服務現有與未來之MH社區居民。MH社區之租賃業務有助於提升我們之入住率、財產表現與現金流。本公司RV社區設計為提供個人與家庭可負擔之度假機會，並搭配多樣化之高品質設施。在英國，本公司所稱之UK社區為「度假公園」，主要位於英格蘭南部不可取代之海濱景點。本公司為度假屋所有者提供度假屋銷售及相關場地許可活動。

2025年，本公司持續執行資產組合最佳化與簡化策略，完成Safe Harbor Sale交易，總淨現金進帳為55億美元，產生總出售利潤為15億美元。Safe Harbor Sale加速我們專注核心業務之策略，並顯著改善我們之負債結構與財務彈性。我們已將Safe Harbor Sale所得之大部分現金用於執行一項資本配置計畫，反映一項平衡且稅務效率高的方式，以透過顯著降低負債、提高財務彈性以推動可持續現金流成長，以及一項審慎之資本回報策略，以優化股東價值。有關Safe Harbor Sale之更多資訊，請參閱我們所附合併財務報表之附註2，「待售資產與已終止業務」。

根據我們之資產組合最佳化策略，2025年我們完成具成長導向之投資與取得機會，同時持續執行目標性資產處置計畫，以處置非戰略性資產，簡化管理並維持財務彈性。截至2025年12月31日，我們取得11處MH與3處RV不動產，總現金對價為4.57億美元，並購回所有32處先前透過地面租賃控制之英國不動產之所有權，總現金對價為3.868億美元。此外，我們在該年度出售4處MH不動產、3處RV不動產及3處開發用地，總出售價格為2.026億美元。不動產處置有助於強化我們之財務狀況，使我們得以減少負債並退出非核心市場。我們持續著重於最大化不動產收入、同社區NOI成長及核心FFO每股成長，我們相信這將有助於提升長期股東價值。
查理·D·楊自2025年10月1日起擔任本公司CEO及董事。楊先生接替蓋瑞·席夫曼，席夫曼先生在擔任本公司CEO40年後退休。我們與楊先生簽訂聘書，他將擔任本公司CEO為期五年，之後自動續約為連續一年一期，除非任一方及時終止該聘書。有關楊先生聘書之更多資訊，請參閱2025年7月23日向SEC提交之Form 8-K。
席夫曼先生將繼續擔任本公司董事會主席。有關席夫曼先生過渡服務協議之更多資訊，請參閱2025年12月16日向SEC提交之Form 8-K。
SUN COMMUNITIES, INC. 管理摘要 2025 年總體概覽
重要營運與財務亮點包含以下內容：
•完成Safe Harbor Marinas業務的處分，總計購價為56.5億美元。
•取得11處MH及三處RV不動產，總計現金對價為4.57億美元，主要來自1031交換保管帳戶，以降低Safe Harbor出售所產生的稅務影響。
•以平均每股125.62美元的價格回購430萬股本公司普通股，總計5.391億美元。
•完成贖回95.65億美元的未擔保高收益票據，包含預付費用5.65億美元。
•完成償還高收益信貸融資下16億美元及7.377億美元的擔保抵押貸款債務，包含預付費用4.59億美元。

headings: 總體經濟情勢及本公司 MH、RV 與 UK 不動產集中於特定地理區域之情形，可能影響本公司產生營業收入之能力。
競爭情形可能影響出租率與租金，進而對本公司營業收入產生不利影響。
RV 與 UK 業務之週期性與季節性特性，可能導致本公司營運成果之波動。
本公司可能無法整合或籌資取得之資產，且取得之資產可能無法達成預期之績效。
透過合資企業進行之投資，可能涉及單獨所有不動產所不存在之風險。
許多不動產位於經歷極端天氣條件與天然災害之區域，氣候變遷可能對本公司業務產生不利影響。
本公司可能因取得之不動產或自有營運之不動產之環境條件，而需承擔環境法規所規定之責任。
本公司因國際投資而面臨額外之風險。
我們可能無法整合或籌措資金以進行擴張及發展活動。
公共衛生危機，例如疾病爆發，可能會對我們的財務狀況、營運成果及現金流造成重大且不利的影響。
租賃管制法規可能會影響我們提高租金的能力。
我們的債務可能會限制我們的營運彈性，或以其他方式對我們的財務狀況造成不利影響，我們未來可能進一步增加債務。
我們信貸協議及高級無擔保債券契約中的約束條款可能會限制我們的彈性，並對我們的財務狀況造成不利影響。
我們的避險策略可能無法成功降低與利率相關的風險，並可能降低您投資的總回報。
我們的信用評級若遭降級，可能會對我們的業務及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
如果我們未能符合REIT的條件，可能會面臨不利的稅務後果，並可能無法吸引資金。
美國聯邦、州及外國所得稅法規針對REITs及其相關解釋可能隨時變更，任何影響REITs之立法或其他措施可能對本公司產生負面影響。
本公司預期-operating partnership將被課稅為合夥企業，但本公司無法保證其將符合相關條件。
合夥企業稅務稽查規則可能對本公司產生重大不利影響。
本公司累積現金之能力可能因某些REIT分紅要求而受到限制。
本公司之可課稅REIT子公司，或TRSs，受特殊規則限制，可能導致稅務負擔增加。
REITs所支付之股息不適用於某些股息之減稅率。
符合REIT要求可能導致本公司放棄其他較具吸引力之機會。
本公司治理文件中之某些條款可能使第三方取得本公司變得困難。
本公司每股價格可能波動且可能下跌，導致股東投資產生重大或完全虧損。
本公司普通股或優先股大量銷售或發行可能導致本公司股票價格下跌。
本公司營運可能無法產生足夠現金以支應本公司資本股票的股息或償還債務，本公司可能調整普通股股息發放政策。
本公司依賴關鍵管理層。
網路安全事件或其他中斷可能影響本公司資訊並使本公司面臨法律責任，此情形可能導致本公司營運與聲譽受損。
人工智慧（"AI"）在職場的發展與應用可能帶來風險與挑戰，可能對本公司營運與營收產生不利影響。
超過本公司保險賠付範圍或未投保的損失
paragraphs: 本公司未來展望受到某些不確定性與風險影響。未來結果可能與目前結果有重大差異，且實際結果可能與前瞻性的陳述有重大差異，原因在於某些風險因素。這些風險因素包括，但不僅限於下列所列風險因素、其他一次性事件，以及先前及時不時於本公司向SEC提交的其他申報文件中披露的重要因素。
與本公司MH、RV及UK業務相關的重要風險
本公司目前市場的總體經濟狀況，特別是在目前市場的都會區，可能顯著影響出租率或租金。出租率與租金，進而可能顯著影響本公司營業收入，若本公司不動產無法產生足夠收入以支應營運費用，包括債務償還及資本支出，則本公司現金流及償還或重新融資債務義務的能力可能受到不利影響。

截至2025年12月31日，本公司MH、RV及UK社區總計125個，佔開發完成場地的26.4%，位於佛羅裏達州；89個社區，佔開發完成場地的19.4%，位於密歇根州；53個社區，佔開發完成場地的12.1%，位於英國；29個社區，佔開發完成場地的6.1%，位於德克薩斯州；以及37個社區，佔開發完成場地的4.9%，位於加利福尼亞州。由於本公司社區在佛羅裏達州、密歇根州、英國、德克薩斯州及加利福尼亞州的地理集中，本公司面臨當地經濟衰退或其他當地不動產市場條件的風險，這些風險可能對這些市場的出租率、租金及不動產價值造成不利影響。

若租戶及旅客無法支付租金，或無法以有利條件出租場地，則本公司收入亦可能受到不利影響。若本公司無法迅速重新出租或續約大量場地，或重新出租或續約時的租金顯著低於預期租金，則本公司業務及營運結果可能受到不利影響。此外，與每個不動產相關的某些支出（例如地價稅及維護費用）通常在因情勢導致不動產收入減少時不會減少。此外，不動產投資相對流動性較低，因此會限制本公司根據經濟或其他條件的變化迅速調整投資組合的能力。
以下因素，以及其他因素，可能對本公司不動產產生的收入造成不利影響：
